description: Default capability for the main window. Deliberately minimal: this grants the webview IPC access to plugin commands, and every dialog in Ember is opened from Rust through `DialogExt`, which does not go through this ACL. `dialog:allow-open` and `dialog:allow-save` were removed with the `@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog` JS binding that never called them - a file picker the renderer can reach is worth having only if something reaches it.
